author: GamingBolt
description:
In part three of our full Resident Evil recap, we discussed the events of Resident Evil 1, the second chronological game in the franchise. Here in part four, we’re going to move our focus to Resident Evil 2 (specifically, its 2018 remake), which finally brings us to the iconic Raccoon City- which is where things really start going wrong on a much, much larger scale than anything that has come before.

Raccoon City is where the ugly consequences of Umbrella’s experiments with bioweapons and deadly viruses rear their head- but before we get into that, it’s important to go over some important events related specifically to the Umbrella scientist William Birkin, the creator of the G-Virus, whose hubris turns out to be the downfall of all of Raccoon City.

author: GamingBolt
description:
Code Vein II is finally here and it's definitely bigger and better than the original game. It's also a lot of fun to play for those of you who enjoy a combat system that's both deep in its build potential and fast and fluid in its execution. 

However, a few annoyances that make their way back from the original game do take away from the overall quality on offer in this ambitious sequel. If you can ignore those, we can safely say that we came away impressed with everything Bandai Namco has done to expand the size and scope of the narrative, combat, and the brand new open-world approach.
title: Code Vein 2 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
So, Highguard is finally out with Wildlight Entertainment, breaking its silence and hosting a showcase to explain exactly what the game is. And yet, the only thought I had before getting to the Developer Vision part was, “Wow, they sound even less enthusiastic than I do to play this.”

You can't really blame me, or the tens of thousands of other players who were skeptical upon seeing the first trailer, calling it Concord 2. A free-to-play competitive shooter already has an uphill battle to climb, and as gorgeous as those visuals are, nothing about Highguard really stood out as unique, be it in the character design, environments, or premise. Again, that was weeks ago, and we only had a single trailer to go off of. Even at my most cynical, it felt like the right time to really dissect the experience was when we knew more, or, if it ever made that point, to actually go hands-on or not.
title: Highguard - Why Do Gamers HATE It?
